answer: A bond of 51% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in umber, and opal reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 123 aliases, and each one needs its own funded voyage account. A farm of 997 identities would post 2031 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
